avoid_supplements.name: Magnesium antacids/supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Magnesium chelates nitrofurantoin, reducing GI absorption and urinary concentrations needed for efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2-3 hours; use alternative antacids if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Probenecid
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Inhibits renal tubular secretion of nitrofurantoin, reducing urinary drug concentration and antimicrobial efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative antibiotic

caution_supplements.name: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Nitrofurantoin may increase risk of peripheral neuropathy; B6 supplementation may provide protective benefit
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for neuropathic symptoms; supplementation may be beneficial with chronic use

caution_supplements.name: Probiotics
caution_supplements.mechanism: May help restore intestinal flora disrupted by nitrofurantoin antibiotic activity
caution_supplements.action: Consider taking 2+ hours apart from nitrofurantoin; use viable strains

avoid_foods.name: High-dose vitamin C/acidifying foods (cranberry, citrus in excess)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Excessive urinary acidification may precipitate nitrofurantoin crystals in renal tubules, increasing nephrotoxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Maintain normal fluid intake; avoid megadose vitamin C; moderate cranberry use acceptable

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay nitrofurantoin absorption, but improves GI tolerance and reduces nausea
caution_foods.action: Take with food if GI upset occurs; absorption remains adequate

caution_foods.name: Dairy products/calcium-rich foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May modestly reduce absorption; effect is minimal with normal dietary intake
caution_foods.action: Space dosing 2 hours apart from high-dose calcium supplements; dietary calcium acceptable

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function (CrCl <60 mL/min requires dose adjustment), urinalysis for crystals, and signs of peripheral neuropathy with prolonged use. Ensure adequate hydration to maintain therapeutic urinary concentrations and reduce crystalluria risk.
